categories.main_business_segments: KOEI TECMO Holdings operates four main business segments: Entertainment (development and sales of entertainment content such as video games), Amusement (development of LCDs for slot/pachinko machines and amusement facility operations), Real Estate (management and leasing of rental properties), and Other (venture capital and securities management). The Entertainment segment is the core, accounting for the majority of revenue and profit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary game development engines, notably the in-house 'KATANA ENGINE,' which is continually enhanced for high-end graphics and multi-platform support. They also utilize general-purpose game engines for some titles, and employ AI-driven automation for debugging and production efficiency. The company emphasizes high-quality content creation and robust IP protection through active patenting and internal R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are global consumers of console, PC, and mobile games, as well as amusement facility operators and slot/pachinko manufacturers. Major end markets include Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia, with significant sales through digital platforms (Apple, Google, Sony, Valve) and licensing partners. The company also serves real estate tenants and venture investment partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: KOEI TECMO has a global footprint with operations in Japan, North America (notably the US), Europe (UK), Greater China (China, Taiwan), and Southeast Asia (Singapore, Vietnam). The majority of revenue is generated in Japan, but overseas sales, especially in North America, Europe, and Asia, are substantial and growing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the supply chain, focusing on the development, publishing, and distribution of finished entertainment content and services directly to end-users and platform holders. In the amusement business, it acts as a midstream supplier of LCD software and content to machine manufacturers and facility operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening global IP creation and expansion, investing in AAA-quality game development, and enhancing global marketing and publishing capabilities. R&D focuses on proprietary engine development, AI-driven production, and multi-platform support. The company is also expanding into new genres and markets, with a strong emphasis on talent development, sustainability, and governance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of packaged and digital games (console, PC, mobile), in-game purchases, licensing and royalty income from IP, amusement facility operations, and real estate leasing. Additional income comes from venture capital investments and securities management. Subscription and royalty models are increasingly important, especially for online/mobile and licensing businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KOEI TECMO is positioned as a leading Japanese digital entertainment company, competing with major domestic and global publishers such as Bandai Namco, Capcom, Square Enix, and SEGA. It is recognized for its strong original IP (e.g., Dynasty Warriors, Nobunaga’s Ambition, Atelier series) and high profitability, with a reputation for quality and niche historical/cultural content.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥83.2 billion with operating profit of ¥32.1 billion and net profit of ¥37.6 billion. The company has shown steady growth in both revenue and profit over the past five years, maintaining high operating margins (targeting 30%+). The workforce is approximately 2,700 employees, and the company is financially robust with significant cash reserves and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOEI TECMO differentiates itself through the creation of high-quality, original IP with strong historical and cultural themes, proprietary technology, and a global multi-platform strategy. The company emphasizes 'Quality & Satisfaction' for customers, aiming to deliver unique, emotionally impactful experiences and maximize IP value through cross-media expansion and global partnerships.
